title: OLTP point read/write latency
statement: The system shall serve single-node or single-edge point reads by identifier within 10 ms and point writes within 20 ms at the 99th percentile in a 3-AZ single-region deployment on SSD storage, at 70% of rated cluster throughput.
rationale: PO decision on p99 targets; a GQL MATCH on an identifier must resolve to a single key read.

acceptance_criteria.text: YCSB workloads A, B, C and F, mapped to GQL MATCH/SET/INSERT on node identifiers, run for 30 minutes each at 70% of rated throughput; p99 read latency ≤ 10 ms.
In the same runs, p99 write latency ≤ 20 ms.
